Modification Discription: An optional argument, seed, has been added to kmeans and kmeans2 to set the random generator and random state.
Function Description: Classify a set of observations into k clusters using the k-means algorithm.

Modification Discription: An optional argument, seed, has been added to kmeans and kmeans2 to set the random generator and random state.
Function Description: Performs k-means on a set of observation vectors forming k clusters.

Modification Discription: The parameters axis and keepdims where added to scipy.spatial.distance.jensenshannon.
Function Description: Compute the Jensen-Shannon distance (metric) between two probability arrays. This is the square root of the Jensen-Shannon divergence.

Modification Discription: The parameter seed was added to scipy.spatial.vq.kmeans and scipy.spatial.vq.kmeans2.
The parameter seed was added to scipy.spatial.vq.kmeans and scipy.spatial.vq.kmeans2.

The new function scipy.stats.binomtest replaces scipy.stats.binom_test. The new function returns an object that calculates a confidence intervals of the proportion parameter. Also, performance was improved from O(n) to O(log(n)) by using binary search.
Function Description:
Perform a test that the probability of success is p.

The binomial test [1] is a test of the null hypothesis that the probability of success in a Bernoulli experiment is p.

Modification Discription: The Alexander-Govern test is implemented in the new function scipy.stats.alexandergovern
Function Description: Performs the Alexander Govern test.

Modification Discription: The new function scipy.stats.page_trend_test performs Page’s test for ordered alternatives.
Function Description: Perform Page’s Test, a measure of trend in observations between treatments.

Modification Discription: The new function scipy.stats.somersd performs Somers’ D test for ordinal association between two variables.
Function Description: Calculates Somers’ D, an asymmetric measure of ordinal association.

Modification Discription: An option, permutations, has been added in scipy.stats.ttest_ind to perform permutation t-tests. A trim option was also added to perform a trimmed (Yuen’s) t-test.
Function Description: Calculate the T-test for the means of two independent samples of scores.

Modification Discription: The new function scipy.stats.differential_entropy estimates the differential entropy of a continuous distribution from a sample.
Function Description: Given a sample of a distribution, estimate the differential entropy.

Modification Discription: scipy.linalg.pinv2 is deprecated and its functionality is completely subsumed into scipy.linalg.pinv
Function Description: Calculate a generalized inverse of a matrix using its singular-value decomposition and including all ‘large’ singular values.

Modification Discription: Both rcond, cond keywords of scipy.linalg.pinv and scipy.linalg.pinvh were not working and now are deprecated. They are now replaced with functioning atol and rtol keywords with clear usage.
Function Description: Compute the (Moore-Penrose) pseudo-inverse of a matrix.

Modification Discription: Both rcond, cond keywords of scipy.linalg.pinv and scipy.linalg.pinvh were not working and now are deprecated. They are now replaced with functioning atol and rtol keywords with clear usage.
Function Description: Compute the (Moore-Penrose) pseudo-inverse of a Hermitian matrix.

Modification Discription: The new function scipy.stats.contingency.crosstab computes a contingency table (i.e. a table of counts of unique entries) for the given data.
Function Description: Return table of counts for each possible unique combination in *args.

Modification Discription: A new function scipy.stats.contingency.relative_risk calculates the relative risk, or risk ratio, of a 2x2 contingency table. The object returned has a method to compute the confidence interval of the relative risk.
Function Description: Compute the relative risk (also known as the risk ratio).

Modification Discription: The new function scipy.stats.contingency.association computes several measures of association for a contingency table: Pearsons contingency coefficient, Cramer’s V, and Tschuprow’s T.
Function Description: Calculates degree of association between two nominal variables.

Modification Discription: The parameter nan_policy was added to scipy.stats.zmap to provide options for handling the occurrence of nan in the input data.
Function Description: Calculate the relative z-scores.

Modification Discription: The parameter ddof was added to scipy.stats.variation and scipy.stats.mstats.variation.
Function Description: Compute the coefficient of variation.

Modification Discription: The parameter weights was added to scipy.stats.gmean.
Function Description: Compute the weighted geometric mean along the specified axis.

Modification Discription: The parameter ddof was added to scipy.stats.variation and scipy.stats.mstats.variation.
Function Description: Compute the coefficient of variation.

Modification Discription: Added an orthogonalize=None parameter to the real transforms in scipy.fft which controls whether the modified definition of DCT/DST is used without changing the overall scaling.
Function Description: Compute the 1-D discrete Fourier Transform.

Modification Discription: scipy.linalg gained three new public array structure investigation functions. scipy.linalg.bandwidth returns information about the bandedness of an array and can be used to test for triangular structure discovery, while scipy.linalg.issymmetric and scipy.linalg.ishermitian test the array for exact and approximate symmetric/Hermitian structure.
Function Description: Return the lower and upper bandwidth of a 2D numeric array.

Modification Discription: scipy.linalg gained three new public array structure investigation functions. scipy.linalg.bandwidth returns information about the bandedness of an array and can be used to test for triangular structure discovery, while scipy.linalg.issymmetric and scipy.linalg.ishermitian test the array for exact and approximate symmetric/Hermitian structure.
Function Description: Check if a square 2D array is symmetric.

Modification Discription: scipy.linalg gained three new public array structure investigation functions. scipy.linalg.bandwidth returns information about the bandedness of an array and can be used to test for triangular structure discovery, while scipy.linalg.issymmetric and scipy.linalg.ishermitian test the array for exact and approximate symmetric/Hermitian structure.
Function Description: Check if a square 2D array is Hermitian.

Modification Discription: scipy.optimize.check_grad introduces two new optional keyword only arguments, direction and seed. direction can take values, 'all' (default), in which case all the one hot direction vectors will be used for verifying the input analytical gradient function and 'random', in which case a random direction vector will be used for the same purpose. seed (default is None) can be used for reproducing the return value of check_grad function. It will be used only when direction='random'.
Function Description: Check the correctness of a gradient function by comparing it against a (forward) finite-difference approximation of the gradient.

Modification Discription: Add scipy.spatial.distance.kulczynski1 in favour of scipy.spatial.distance.kulsinski which will be deprecated in the next release.
Function Description: Compute the Kulczynski 1 dissimilarity between two boolean 1-D arrays.

Modification Discription: Add scipy.spatial.distance.kulczynski1 in favour of scipy.spatial.distance.kulsinski which will be deprecated in the next release.
Function Description: Compute the Kulsinski dissimilarity between two boolean 1-D arrays. Provide 10 solutions

Modification Discription: The new function scipy.special.log_expit computes the logarithm of the logistic sigmoid function. The function is formulated to provide accurate results for large positive and negative inputs, so it avoids the problems that would occur in the naive implementation log(expit(x)).
Function Description: Logarithm of the logistic sigmoid function.

Modification Discription: scipy.stats.qmc.LatinHypercube introduces two new optional keyword-only arguments, optimization and strength. optimization is either None or random-cd. In the latter, random permutations are performed to improve the centered discrepancy. strength is either 1 or 2. 1 corresponds to the classical LHS while 2 has better sub-projection properties. This construction is referred to as an orthogonal array based LHS of strength 2. In both cases, the output is still a LHS.
Function Description: Latin hypercube sampling (LHS).

Modification Discription: Add scipy.stats.gzscore to calculate the geometrical z score.
Function Description: Compute the geometric standard score.

Modification Discription: Added the Tukey-Kramer test as scipy.stats.tukey_hsd.
Function Description: Perform Tukey’s HSD test for equality of means over multiple treatments.

Modification Discription: Added the parameter keepdims to scipy.stats.variation and prevent the undesirable return of a masked array from the function in some cases.
Function Description: Compute the coefficient of variation.

Modification Discription:
SciPy has always documented what its public API consisted of in its API reference docs, however there never was a clear split between public and private namespaces in the code base. In this release, all namespaces that were private but happened to miss underscores in their names have been deprecated. These include (as examples, there are many more):

scipy.signal.spline

scipy.ndimage.filters

scipy.ndimage.fourier

scipy.ndimage.measurements

scipy.ndimage.morphology

scipy.ndimage.interpolation

scipy.sparse.linalg.solve

scipy.sparse.linalg.eigen

scipy.sparse.linalg.isolve

Function Description: Solve the sparse linear system Ax=b, where b may be a vector or a matrix.
Find k eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the square matrix A.
Solve the sparse linear system Ax=b, where b may be a vector or a matrix.

Modification Discription: NumericalInverseHermite has been deprecated from scipy.stats and moved to the scipy.stats.sampling submodule.
Function Description: approximates the inverse of a continuous statistical distribution’s CDF with a Hermite spline. Order of the hermite spline can be specified by passing the order parameter.

Modification Discription: A new global optimizer, scipy.optimize.direct (DIviding RECTangles algorithm) was added. For problems with inexpensive function evaluations, like the ones in the SciPy benchmark suite, direct is competitive with the best other solvers in SciPy (dual_annealing and differential_evolution) in terms of execution time.
Function Description: Finds the global minimum of a function using the DIRECT algorithm.

Modification Discription: Add a full_output parameter to scipy.optimize.curve_fit to output additional solution information.
Function Description: Use non-linear least squares to fit a function, f, to data.

Modification Discription: Add a integrality parameter to scipy.optimize.differential_evolution, enabling integer constraints on parameters.
Function Description: Finds the global minimum of a multivariate function.

Modification Discription: Added scipy.optimize.milp, new function for mixed-integer linear programming.
Function Description: Mixed-integer linear programming

Modification Discription: The new window function scipy.signal.windows.kaiser_bessel_derived was added to compute the Kaiser-Bessel derived window.
Function Description: Return a Kaiser-Bessel derived window.

Modification Discription:
Add a copy parameter to scipy.sparce.csgraph.laplacian. Using inplace computation with copy=False reduces the memory footprint. Add a dtype parameter to scipy.sparce.csgraph.laplacian for type casting.

Add a symmetrized parameter to scipy.sparce.csgraph.laplacian to produce symmetric Laplacian for directed graphs.                                            Add a form parameter to scipy.sparce.csgraph.laplacian taking one of the three values: array, or function, or lo determining the format of the output Laplacian: * array is a numpy array (backward compatible default); * function is a pointer to a lambda-function evaluating the Laplacian-vector or Laplacian-matrix product; * lo results in the format of the LinearOperator.
Function Description: Return the Laplacian of a directed graph.

Modification Discription: Add an order parameter to scipy.spatial.transform.Rotation.from_quat and scipy.spatial.transform.Rotation.as_quat to specify quaternion format.
Function Description: Initialize from quaternions.

Modification Discription: Add an order parameter to scipy.spatial.transform.Rotation.from_quat and scipy.spatial.transform.Rotation.as_quat to specify quaternion format.
Function Description: Represent as quaternions.

Modification Discription: Add a weights parameter to scipy.stats.hmean
Function Description: Calculate the weighted harmonic mean along the specified axis.

Modification Discription: Added scipy.stats.fit for fitting discrete and continuous distributions to data.
Function Description: Fit a discrete or continuous distribution to data

Modification Discription: Add a bits parameter to scipy.stats.qmc.Sobol. It allows to use from 0 to 64 bits to compute the sequence. Default is None which corresponds to 30 for backward compatibility. Using a higher value allow to sample more points. Note: bits does not affect the output dtype.
Function Description: Engine for generating (scrambled) Sobol’ sequences.

Modification Discription: Add scipy.stats.pmean to calculate the weighted power mean also called generalized mean.
Function Description: Calculate the weighted power mean along the specified axis.

Modification Discription: Add scipy.stats.qmc.PoissonDisk to sample using the Poisson disk sampling method. It guarantees that samples are separated from each other by a given radius.
Function Description: Poisson disk sampling.

Modification Discription: A new dedicated datasets submodule (scipy.datasets) has been added, and is now preferred over usage of scipy.misc for dataset retrieval.
Added parameter complex_func to scipy.integrate.quad, which can be set True to integrate a complex integrand.
Function Description: Compute a definite integral.

Modification Discription: A new extrapolate argument is available to scipy.interpolate.BSpline.design_matrix, allowing extrapolation based on the first and last intervals.
Function Description: Returns a design matrix as a CSR format sparse array.

Modification Discription: A new function scipy.interpolate.make_smoothing_spline has been added. It is an implementation of the generalized cross-validation spline smoothing algorithm. The lam=None (default) mode of this function is a clean-room reimplementation of the classic gcvspl.f Fortran algorithm for constructing GCV splines.
Function Description: Compute the (coefficients of) smoothing cubic spline function using lam to control the tradeoff between the amount of smoothness of the curve and its proximity to the data. In case lam is None, using the GCV criteria to find it.

Modification Discription: A new radius argument is supported by scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter1d and scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter for adjusting the kernel size of the filter.
Function Description: 1-D Gaussian filter.

Modification Discription: A new radius argument is supported by scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter1d and scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter for adjusting the kernel size of the filter.
Function Description: Multidimensional Gaussian filter.

Modification Discription: The new window function scipy.signal.windows.lanczos was added to compute a Lanczos window, also known as a sinc window.
Function Description: Return a Lanczos window also known as a sinc window.

Modification Discription: The new function scipy.special.powm1, a ufunc with signature powm1(x, y), computes x**y - 1. The function avoids the loss of precision that can result when y is close to 0 or when x is close to 1.
Function Description:
Computes x**y - 1.

This function is useful when y is near 0, or when x is near 1.

The function is implemented for real types only (unlike numpy.power, which accepts complex inputs).

Modification Discription: Added scipy.stats.goodness_of_fit, a generalized goodness-of-fit test for use with any univariate distribution, any combination of known and unknown parameters, and several choices of test statistic (Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Cramer-von Mises, and Anderson-Darling).
Function Description: Perform a goodness of fit test comparing data to a distribution family.

Modification Discription: scipy.stats.qmc.LatinHypercube parameter centered has been deprecated. It is replaced by the scramble argument for more consistency with other QMC engines.
Function Description: Latin hypercube sampling (LHS)

Modification Discription: Added a parameter optimization to all scipy.stats.qmc.QMCEngine subclasses to improve characteristics of the quasi-random variates.
Function Description: A generic Quasi-Monte Carlo sampler class meant for subclassing.

Modification Discription: scipy.misc module and all the methods in misc are deprecated in v1.10 and will be completely removed in SciPy v2.0.0. Users are suggested to utilize the scipy.datasets module instead for the dataset methods.
scipy.interpolate.interp2d class has been deprecated. The docstring of the deprecated routine lists recommended replacements.
Function Description: Interpolate over a 2-D grid.

Modification Discription: Added scipy.integrate.qmc_quad for quasi-Monte Carlo integration.
Function Description: Compute an integral in N-dimensions using Quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature.

Modification Discription:
scipy.ndimage improvements
axes argument was added to rank_filter, percentile_filter, median_filter, uniform_filter, minimum_filter, maximum_filter, and gaussian_filter, which can be useful for processing stacks of image data.
Function Description: Calculate a multidimensional rank filter.
Calculate a multidimensional percentile filter.
Calculate a multidimensional median filter.
Multidimensional uniform filter.
Calculate a multidimensional minimum filter.
Calculate a multidimensional maximum filter.
Multidimensional Gaussian filter.

Modification Discription: scipy.optimize.lsq_linear now accepts bounds arguments of type scipy.optimize.Bounds.
Function Description: Solve a linear least-squares problem with bounds on the variables.

Modification Discription: scipy.optimize.curve_fit now supports an optional nan_policy argument.
scipy.optimize.shgo now has parallelization with the workers argument, symmetry arguments that can improve performance, class-based design to improve usability, and generally improved performance.
Function Description: Finds the global minimum of a function using SHG optimization.

Modification Discription: scipy.sparse.isspmatrix now only returns True for the sparse matrices instances. scipy.sparse.issparse now has to be used instead to check for instances of sparse arrays or instances of sparse matrices.
Function Description: Is x of a sparse matrix type?

Modification Discription: scipy.stats.sobol_indices, a method to compute Sobol’ sensitivity indices.
Function Description: Global sensitivity indices of Sobol’.

Modification Discription: scipy.stats.dunnett, which performs Dunnett’s test of the means of multiple experimental groups against the mean of a control group.
Function Description: Dunnett’s test: multiple comparisons of means against a control group.

Modification Discription: scipy.stats.ecdf for computing the empirical CDF and complementary CDF (survival function / SF) from uncensored or right-censored data. This function is also useful for survival analysis / Kaplan-Meier estimation.
Function Description: Empirical cumulative distribution function of a sample.

Modification Discription: scipy.stats.logrank to compare survival functions underlying samples.
Function Description: Compare the survival distributions of two samples via the logrank test.

Modification Discription: scipy.stats.false_discovery_control for adjusting p-values to control the false discovery rate of multiple hypothesis tests using the Benjamini-Hochberg or Benjamini-Yekutieli procedures.
Function Description: Adjust p-values to control the false discovery rate.

Modification Discription: The scipy.linalg functions tri, triu & tril are deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1.13. Users are recommended to use the NumPy versions of these functions with identical names.
Function Description: Construct (N, M) matrix filled with ones at and below the kth diagonal. The matrix has A[i,j] == 1 for j <= i + k

Modification Discription: The scipy.linalg functions tri, triu & tril are deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1.13. Users are recommended to use the NumPy versions of these functions with identical names.
Function Description: Make a copy of a matrix with elements below the kth diagonal zeroed.

Modification Discription: The scipy.linalg functions tri, triu & tril are deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1.13. Users are recommended to use the NumPy versions of these functions with identical names.
Function Description: Make a copy of a matrix with elements above the kth diagonal zeroed.

Modification Discription: The scipy.signal functions bspline, quadratic & cubic are deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1.13. Users are recommended to use scipy.interpolate.BSpline instead.
Function Description: B-spline basis function of order n.

Modification Discription: The scipy.signal functions bspline, quadratic & cubic are deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1.13. Users are recommended to use scipy.interpolate.BSpline instead.
Function Description:
A quadratic B-spline.

This is a special case of bspline, and equivalent to bspline(x, 2).

Modification Discription: The scipy.signal functions bspline, quadratic & cubic are deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1.13. Users are recommended to use scipy.interpolate.BSpline instead.
Function Description:
A cubic B-spline.

This is a special case of bspline, and equivalent to bspline(x, 3).

Modification Discription: The even keyword of scipy.integrate.simpson is deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1.13.0. Users should leave this as the default as this gives improved accuracy compared to the other methods
Function Description: Integrate y(x) using samples along the given axis and the composite Simpson’s rule. If x is None, spacing of dx is assumed.

Modification Discription: The functions scipy.signal.{lsim2, impulse2, step2} had long been deprecated in documentation only. They now raise a DeprecationWarning and will be removed in SciPy 1.13.0.
Function Description: Simulate output of a continuous-time linear system, by using the ODE solver scipy.integrate.odeint.

Modification Discription: The functions scipy.signal.{lsim2, impulse2, step2} had long been deprecated in documentation only. They now raise a DeprecationWarning and will be removed in SciPy 1.13.0.
Function Description: Impulse response of a single-input, continuous-time linear system.

Modification Discription: The functions scipy.signal.{lsim2, impulse2, step2} had long been deprecated in documentation only. They now raise a DeprecationWarning and will be removed in SciPy 1.13.0.
Function Description: Step response of continuous-time system.
